subject: RE: FW: BRUSSELS AIRPORT - JNB / 228 PCS 212 KGS
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote your fastest air freight option to SGN (Ho Chi Minh City, VN) for 7 pieces of textile samples? The shipment has a gross weight of 664 kg and a volume of 5.17 cbm.

The goods will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-25 at our site in 93294 (Regensburg), Germany. Please arrange truck pickup from our site and transport to the departure airport.

Please provide an all-in price in EUR, including the pickup and road transport, and confirm the earliest available pickup and expected arrival at SGN.

Thank you for your assistance.

By the way, we already have an offer of roughly 2130 EUR all-in from another forwarder. I hope you can get close to that.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm


-----Original Message-----
Sent: 2026-10-22
Subject: BRUSSELS AIRPORT - JNB / 228 PCS 212 KGS

Dear team,

pls quote air freight ex BRUSSELS AIRPORT to JNB:
228 PCS / 212 KGS / 5.2 CBM, furniture samples
FCA, cargo ready next week.

Thanks

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new all-in air freight quote for a shipment from Germany to SGN.
